name: spike-gaps
//: The board-copy-gaps feasibility spike, preserved on its branch and never landed. Its tests drive target/debug/onetaskgraph and the prototype, so `test` depends on both builds; it is a member of the root uv workspace, so every target runs in the workspace's one environment, resolved by the root uv.lock. `build` builds the reachability-closure prototype the offline tests run; the live probes are never a target, because they spend the test board's shared GitHub allowance and run only from spike/gaps/gaps.sh.

bootstrap.//: Uncached: it reaches PyPI and writes the workspace .venv. Inexact, so the other members' packages stay installed.

options.command: uv run --frozen ty check gaps tests

build.//: Uncached: it builds into a clone under the user's cache directory, outside the cacheable output set.
